name: Candy Corn Rice Krispy Treats with White & Dark Chocolate (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Line the bottom and sides of a large (9 x 13-inch) baking dish with parchment paper and set aside.
Roughly chop candy corn and set aside.
Place butter in a large pot and melt over medium-low heat.

Add mini marshmallows to the pot with the melted butter and heat, stirring constantly, until melted and combined with the butter, about 5 minutes. Add food coloring, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (283 g) pkg mini marshmallows
1 drop red food coloring
12 drops yellow food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Add chopped candy corn and cereal to the pot, then stir until thoroughly combined.
Pour cereal mixture into the prepared baking dish and, using the back of a metal spoon, spread into the sides, forming an even layer. Set aside to cool, about 1 hour (it will firm up as it cools).

Unmold the cooled marshmallow treat and transfer to a cutting board. Cut in half lengthwise, then cut each section into triangles that are about 3 inches wide at the base. (You will end up with some waste from the beginning and end of each long piece.) Feel free to enjoy these while you work or press them together to form full-sized triangles. We ended up with 14 triangles total, without using the trimmed pieces.
Use your hands to round the edges of each triangle, creating the "candy corn" shape (if desired). Place on a large baking sheet pan lined with parchment paper.

Place white melting chocolate in a microwave safe bowl. Place bowl in the microwave and heat on 50% power or defrost setting for 1 minute. Stir, then repeat heating at 50% power for 30-second intervals, until smooth and completely melted. Dip the pointed tips of each candy corn treat into the melted chocolate, return to the baking sheet, and set aside until firm, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (283 g) pkg melting white chocolate candy wafers

instructions.primary_message: When the white chocolate is set, place dark melting chocolate in a clean microwave safe bowl. Place bowl in the microwave and heat on 50% power or defrost setting for 1 minute. Stir, then repeat heating at 50% power for 30-second intervals, until smooth and completely melted. Dip the base of each candy corn treat into the melted chocolate, return to the baking sheet, and set aside to set, 10 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (283 g) pkg melting dark chocolate candy wafers

instructions.primary_message: Arrange candy corn treats on a platter, share, and enjoy!
